verses.pali: “Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhammā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these ten things don’t arise apart from the Holy One’s training.
Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti.
verses.english: These are the ten things that don’t arise apart from the Holy One’s training.”
